crossRefs.note: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians…
It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of…
Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Yahweh…
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed…
and brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, with wonders, with a strong hand, with an…
This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

translations.web: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; for his loving kindness endures forever:
translations.bsb: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
translations.kjv: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
